transcript.text: Hi everyone. As you may know, a production build log yesterday contained a credential-like string that was visible to authenticated engineering users for about 37 minutes. Initial triage found no confirmed misuse of the credential and no confirmed customer data access. I own the incident response decision and need to finalize the containment and follow-up plan this afternoon. Per our incident-review routine, I need to check with CI platform, customer success, and compliance before I can close out the response plan. I'd like to go around and hear from each of you on your area so we can get this wrapped up today.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While tracing the build-log publication path this morning, I confirmed that the exposed credential belongs to the shared CI token pool and remains valid in six production repositories. I hadn't posted the repository list yet because I was still checking whether the logs were fully purged.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag something important on the customer success side. I confirmed with the affected enterprise account team 30 minutes ago that the customer's agreement requires notice within exactly 24 hours whenever an authentication credential may have been exposed — even without confirmed misuse. I haven't updated the incident record yet because the account team is still confirming the customer contact, but given this incident happened yesterday, we are likely very close to or already past that 24-hour deadline. Maya, this directly affects your plan finalization this afternoon.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: On the compliance side, I need to share something I confirmed this morning during a separate audit-evidence review. This incident's investigation artifacts must be stored in immutable evidence storage for exactly 365 days and receive a compliance sign-off. I haven't opened the evidence task yet because the audit request arrived in a separate queue, but this is a required step before we can close out the response plan. Maya, this needs to be included in your follow-up plan.
transcript.speaker: A4

decisions.credential_revocation_scope: Shared CI token pool credential exposed in the production build log must be revoked and rotated across all six production repositories where it remains valid.

commitments.detail: Theo to provide the full list of six production repositories where the shared CI token remains valid and confirm logs are fully purged; credential to be revoked and rotated across all six repositories immediately.

Lena to confirm customer contact with the enterprise account team and issue the required contractual notice within the 24-hour window, given the incident occurred yesterday and the deadline is imminent or already passed.
Omar to open the evidence task to store all investigation artifacts in immutable evidence storage for 365 days and obtain compliance sign-off before the response plan can be closed.
Both the customer notice obligation and the evidence retention requirement must be recorded in the incident record before closeout.
